note: Curated component decisions only. Imports, API declarations and JSDoc are generated from source/build; components without entries retain explicit family-level fallback.

MetadataList.chooseWhen: Read-only metadata and label/value facts about one record.
MetadataList.avoidWhen: Editing values or rendering a list of actionable records.
MetadataList.composition: Pass plain labels and semantic values; MetadataList owns typography and label/value gaps.

ContentBlock.chooseWhen: A titled section within a page or existing surface.
ContentBlock.avoidWhen: Needing a full card contract or a modal interaction.
ContentBlock.composition: Use title and description props; compose content within the shared section spacing.

ScrollArea.chooseWhen: A constrained scrollable region that needs consistent scrollbars.
ScrollArea.avoidWhen: Making the entire document scroll or hiding overflowing interactive content.
ScrollArea.composition: Constrain the parent; retain keyboard access and give the region a useful accessible name when needed.

Item.chooseWhen: An identity row with a title, description, media and actions.
Item.avoidWhen: A definition list of facts or an editable field.
Item.composition: Compose ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription and ItemActions; keep facts in MetadataList.

FormField.chooseWhen: An editable control with an associated label, hint and error.
FormField.composition: Put a control inside FormField; let the field own label and support typography.

Card.chooseWhen: A bounded surface with a coordinated header, body and footer.
Card.avoidWhen: Only grouping content within an existing surface or temporarily interrupting a task.
Card.composition: Use CardHeader and CardContent rather than local title, description and inset styles.

Overlay.chooseWhen: Temporary focused interaction over the current page.
Overlay.avoidWhen: Persistent page content or application navigation.
Overlay.composition: Use OverlayHeader, OverlayBody and OverlayFooter; retain dismissal and focus behavior.

TabList.chooseWhen: Scrollable tabs with edge fade and overflow navigation.
TabList.avoidWhen: Independent actions or filtering unrelated to a tabbed content region.
TabList.composition: Place within Tabs with Tab and TabPanel; edgeFade is opt-in and scroll controls appear on overflow.

Text.chooseWhen: Primary copy and supporting text with a stable reusable typography role.
Text.avoidWhen: A field label, surface title or metadata label whose owner already styles it.
Text.composition: Leave ordinary body size unset to inherit provider defaults; use xs for genuine support copy.

DisplayLabel.chooseWhen: A read-only label or group name.
DisplayLabel.composition: Pass plain content, without nested Text or local font overrides.

Stack.chooseWhen: A passive one-dimensional layout with shared spacing.
Stack.avoidWhen: An existing component already owns the layout.
Stack.composition: Use shared gap and inset props; do not pin local pixel spacing.

DataView.chooseWhen: A resource browser combining a table, search, filters and saved views.
DataView.avoidWhen: Only needing a table or replacing one small visual region with a new state machine.
DataView.composition: Start with DataView props and slots; use DataViewShell or useDataView only for a genuinely different arrangement.

DataTable.chooseWhen: A typed table with column, sorting and selection controls.
DataTable.avoidWhen: Needing a complete resource browser with saved views and filters.
DataTable.composition: Keep columns and data policy in the app; use DataView for the surrounding resource workflow.

SearchFilters.chooseWhen: Search and filter controls for a resource collection.
SearchFilters.avoidWhen: Owning a whole resource table or using a tab bar for filter editing.
SearchFilters.composition: Compose with FilterProvider and public editors; reuse FiltersButton for compact overlay access.

FiltersButton.chooseWhen: A compact entry point to filters in an overlay, especially on mobile.
FiltersButton.avoidWhen: Always-visible filter controls with sufficient room.
FiltersButton.composition: Use inside the filter provider so desktop and mobile share the same filter state.

Comments.chooseWhen: Compact comments or posts with replies and a composer.
Comments.avoidWhen: A feed of system events or mixed audit history.
Comments.composition: Use the ready Comments surface before its parts or useComments; the app owns persistence and permissions.

ActivityFeed.chooseWhen: A structured timeline of activity events.
ActivityFeed.avoidWhen: A conversation primarily made of user comments and replies.
ActivityFeed.composition: Use public accessors, callbacks and parts; keep fetching and domain formatting at the consumer boundary.

ActivityLog.chooseWhen: A mixed history of events and discussion.
ActivityLog.avoidWhen: Only a comment thread or a homogeneous event feed.
ActivityLog.composition: Compose the public log contract instead of rebuilding rows, markers or comment states.

ThemeTweaker.chooseWhen: A live theme editor available from every page of an application.
ThemeTweaker.avoidWhen: A static content block or a second independent theme provider.
capabilities: live theme editor from every page
app theme values colors typography density
ThemeTweaker.composition: Mount one launcher at the application shell, bind it to the live theme scope, and let its shared controls own styling.

Page.chooseWhen: A route-level shell with a coherent heading, actions and content.
Page.avoidWhen: A nested card or modal body.
Page.composition: Supply header props and compose content from surfaces and feature families; routing remains application-owned.

Input.chooseWhen: Editable text input for a single-line field.
Input.avoidWhen: Choosing from suggestions or displaying read-only content.
Input.composition: Place inside FormField for its label, hint and error; use controlled values when the app owns state.
